newsitem.title: ITALY: Five die as Italian landslide sweeps cars into sea.
newsitem.headline: Five die as Italian landslide sweeps cars into sea.

text.p: Five people were killed when a landslide caused by two days of torrential rain swept cars off a coastal road in southern Italy, sending some plunging into the sea, police said on Saturday.

Coastguards were still searching the waters between Castellamare di Stabia and Vico Equense to the south of Naples after more than 20 cars were hit by the landslide on Friday on the main coastal road near the popular holiday resort of Sorrento.
A police spokesman said five bodies were recovered from the sea. "There are certainly other injured people," he said.
The landslide occurred when part of a mountain collapsed, burying both the north and south bound lanes in a hail of mud within minutes.
It was not immediately clear how many cars had been sent over the cliff in the landslide. Police and firefighters were also searching for people believed trapped in a nearby building.
Rescue attempts were hindered by a fresh storm.
